hip_drop.label: Hip drop
hip_drop.thresholdSource: Bramah 2019 called pelvic drop aberrant at 5.6° (1 SD above healthy runners); Dingenen 2018 found 2D video can't reliably detect changes under 2.8°. 5.6 + 2.8 = 8.4°.
hip_drop.flaggedMessage: Your hips dropped more than the research cutoff when each foot landed.

recommendation.drill: Raise your step rate by 10% with a metronome
recommendation.rationale: After one session retraining to a 10% higher step rate, runners with knee pain had about 3° less pelvic drop four weeks later.

citations.title: A 10% Increase in Step Rate Improves Running Kinematics and Clinical Outcomes in Runners With Patellofemoral Pain at 4 Weeks and 3 Months
Is There a Pathological Gait Associated With Common Soft Tissue Running Injuries?
Test-retest reliability of two-dimensional video analysis during running

recommendation.evidenceNote: Limited evidence: the step-rate study is a 12-runner case series, and this app's 2D hip drop only approximates the 3D measure the studies used.

video.title: Increasing Running Step Rate in PFP

overstride.label: Overstride
overstride.notJudgedReason: Not judged: landing further ahead of the hip raises braking force, but research gives no cutoff.

cadence.label: Cadence
cadence.notJudgedReason: Not judged: a good cadence depends on your speed, which a video can't measure.

vertical_oscillation.label: Vertical oscillation
vertical_oscillation.notJudgedReason: Not judged: bounce depends on speed and height, and research gives no cutoff.

ground_contact_time.label: Ground contact time
ground_contact_time.notJudgedReason: Not judged: research finds almost no link between contact time and running cost.

flight_time.label: Flight time
flight_time.notJudgedReason: Not judged: research finds almost no link between flight time and running cost.

landing_form.label: Landing form
landing_form.notJudgedReason: Not judged: there's little evidence that heel, midfoot, or forefoot landing changes injury risk.

arm_swing_symmetry.label: Arm swing symmetry
arm_swing_symmetry.notJudgedReason: Not judged: some left-right difference is normal, and research gives no cutoff.
